seoTitle: How to Get a Manus AI Invitation Code (and Alternatives)
metaDescription: Get access to Manus AI through the official invitation process, plus a look at OpenManus as an alternative while you wait for your invite.
intro: Manus AI access is invite-only, and waiting for the official invitation email can feel slow. This guide covers the official method for requesting access as well as OpenManus, an alternative worth trying while you wait, and a warning about invitation code scams.

steps.heading: Use the official request method
steps.body: Sign up through Manus AI's official channel and wait for an invitation email, which has been reported to arrive in as little as a few days for some users.

steps.heading: Try OpenManus as an alternative
steps.body: OpenManus, built by the MetaGPT team, is accessible at openmanus.org and offers similar functionality while you wait for official access.

steps.heading: Watch for a second alternative portal
steps.body: A second alternative option was under testing at the time of this guide and may be worth checking for updates.

steps.heading: Avoid invitation code scams
steps.body: Be cautious of sites or sellers claiming to sell Manus AI invitation codes — these are largely reported as fraudulent, and the real wait time is typically just a few days.

faq.question: How long does it take to get an official Manus AI invitation?
faq.answer: Based on user reports, it can take around 3-5 days after signing up through the official channel.

faq.question: Is it safe to buy a Manus AI invitation code online?
faq.answer: No, sites and sellers claiming to sell invitation codes are largely reported as fraudulent, so it's best to avoid them.

faq.question: What is OpenManus?
faq.answer: OpenManus is an alternative tool built by the MetaGPT team, accessible at openmanus.org, that offers similar functionality while you wait for a Manus AI invite.

faq.question: Are there other alternative access portals?
faq.answer: There was a second alternative portal under testing at the time of this guide, so it's worth checking back for updates on additional access options.
